meta.title: TutorCraft — a friendly online learning platform
meta.description: Build a course in 15 minutes, grade everything in one place, sell your courses and get Telegram notifications.

landing.heroTitle: A course in 15 minutes. Grading in one window.
landing.heroSubtitle: TutorCraft is a platform for tutors and online schools: build courses from blocks, collect assignments and quizzes, sell courses and get Telegram notifications.

create.title: Create a course
create.text: Only a title is required — configure the rest later.

fill.title: Add materials
fill.text: Pages, videos, assignments and quizzes — via “+” between items.

invite.title: Invite students
invite.text: One invite link, or sell the course on its landing page.

grade.title: Grade quickly
grade.text: All submissions from all courses in one queue with shortcuts.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't

builder.title: Block editor
builder.text: Like Notion: text, formulas, code, tables, video and pasted images.

tasks.title: “My tasks”
tasks.text: Students always see what is due and when.

grading.title: Unified grading
grading.text: Three panels, comment templates, J/K and Ctrl+Enter.

quizzes.title: Quizzes
quizzes.text: 8 question types, server timer, autosave on flaky networks.

sales.title: Course sales
sales.text: Price, payment and automatic enrolment after payment.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.text: New submissions, grades and sales — right in your messenger.

mobile.title: Mobile-friendly
mobile.text: Every student flow works on a 360px screen and offline.

gradebook.title: Clear gradebook
gradebook.text: Category weights and a plain-language final grade formula.
